Notes on what the site did and didn't say, for the record:

- 
Tiny Gym is described as the child's first gym class, for the youngest gymnasts with their parent/caregiver, focusing on sensory and gross motor development, coordination, balance, strength, flexibility, social skills, and fun.
 
The 1-year-old participants are strongly recommended to be fully independently walking before the term begins.
 This is their genuine parent-and-tot offering (Mini Gym, by contrast, is for kids who've graduated Tiny Gym and participate without a parent).
- No day/time or price is posted for it on the public programs page — 
availability and pricing are only available by logging into their registration website, since pricing fluctuates term by term as term lengths vary.

- 
Term 1/Fall registration opened Wednesday July 22, 2026 at 8:00am online for all general programming
, so registration for this fall term has already been open for about a month.
